sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live visa-on-arrival nationality endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The live kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw endpoint is served by the Ministry of Interior's current Kuwait Visa platform and returns the platform's arrival-nationality records.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: Visa Instructions
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Kuwait Visa portal is served on the Ministry of Interior subdomain and publishes its visitor-visa instructions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passport validity: No less than 6 months

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: Terms and Conditions
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry of Interior Kuwait Visa portal hosts the terms governing online visa applications.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applications must be submitted through the official website only.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live country-eligibility checker
sources.officialityEvidence: The current public Kuwait Visa application uses this Ministry of Interior endpoint after the traveller selects nationality and relevant category facts.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You are eligible for applying online e-visa.

sources.title: MoI: New E-visa enhances Kuwait's status as attractive tourist destination
sources.officialityEvidence: KUNA is Kuwait's official news agency reporting the Ministry of Interior's presentation of the current Kuwait Visa categories and requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The third category; which is yet to be launch

sources.title: Kuwait Government Online: Tourist Visit
sources.publisher: Kuwait Government Online / Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The current State of Kuwait Government Online service page describes the Ministry of Interior's tourist-visit process and required sponsor documents.

unresolved.reason: Current official sources do not establish this ordinary passport's nationality-wide visitor category. The MOI portal's online selector/checker can depend on a valid US, UK or Schengen tourist visa or residence permit, GCC residence with a listed occupation, document uploads and security review; KUNA says its all-other-nationalities financial category had not yet entered into force. The current arrival endpoint is an enumerated cohort, and e.gov.kw's sponsor process supplies no passport-code exhaustive default. Thus neither an eVisa nor advance-visa baseline is established.
